ding_pbmc.sampling: 1000 cells per prespecified method, uniform without replacement; no cell-type balancing
ding_pbmc.expression_scale: source expression used as supplied; see upstream preprocessing

ding_mixture.sampling: all cells in prespecified Mixture1 / 10x Chromium v2; species labels never used for sampling
ding_mixture.expression_scale: species-blind shared-gene counts; source QC retained

abc_hpf.accession: Allen ABC MERFISH; source metadata retained locally
abc_hpf.sampling: uniform sample of up to 3000 cells in prespecified HPF slice x_CCF 6.8–7.0 mm, DG/CA1/CA2/CA3; no taxonomy balancing
abc_hpf.expression_scale: provided log2 expression over 500 genes; no additional log transform

vasculature.sampling: 2500 cells uniformly sampled from fixed masked 50000-cell search input; donor and biological labels excluded

allen_cortex.accession: Allen whole mouse brain isocortex reference
allen_cortex.sampling: 3000 cells uniformly sampled without replacement from the fixed 20000-cell isocortical reference; no label balancing
allen_cortex.expression_scale: normalize total counts to 10000 over all source genes, log1p, then subset to 2000 Seurat HVGs; no second normalization or log transform
